comment: Mutating operations deliberately not audited. Each needs a reason and a compensating control; the audit-coverage gate fails on an exemption that states neither, and on an operation that is unaudited without appearing here.

exemptions.reason: Records last-seen time on every authenticated request. Emitting an event per request would swamp the log at a volume that hides the events that matter, and the mutation carries no security decision: it advances an activity timestamp and revision, and cannot change who the session belongs to or what it may do.
exemptions.compensating_control: Session creation, rotation, renewal, assurance upgrade and every revocation path are audited, so the session's security-relevant lifecycle is fully recorded without the per-request noise.
